title: Slow-cooker turkey meatballs
subtitle: Lean turkey meatballs cooked slowly in a herbed tomato sauce
excerpt: Turkey mince shaped into meatballs and cooked in a simple tomato sauce until very tender. A lighter alternative to beef meatballs with the same slow-cooker results.
sourceNotes: Turkey meatballs are a popular alternative to beef meatballs in British and American home cooking, particularly for those seeking a leaner option. The slow-cooker method keeps them moist.

recipe.freezeNotes: Freeze in portions for up to 3 months. Defrost overnight in the fridge and reheat gently.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Better after a night in the fridge as the meatballs absorb more sauce.

content.text: Turkey meatballs need more binding than beef meatballs because the mince is leaner and has less fat to hold the mixture together. Use fresh breadcrumbs rather than dried and make sure the egg is well mixed in before forming. The meatballs will be very soft; this is correct. They firm up during cooking.
The cook time is shorter than beef meatballs: 4 to 5 hours on LOW is enough. Beyond that, turkey mince can become slightly grainy.
Serve over spaghetti or in rolls. A grating of Parmesan at the table finishes the dish.

Combine {{turkey-mince}} of turkey mince with {{breadcrumbs-fresh}} of fresh breadcrumbs, {{eggs}} egg, {{italian-seasoning}} of Italian seasoning, {{garlic-powder}} of garlic powder, and {{sea-salt-fine}} of salt. Mix briefly. Shape into balls about the size of a golf ball. The mixture will be soft; wet hands help.

Add {{tinned-tomatoes}} of tinned tomatoes, {{tomato-puree}} of tomato puree, {{garlic}} of crushed garlic, and {{onion}} diced onion to the slow cooker. Stir briefly. Lower the meatballs carefully into the sauce. Set to LOW and cook for 4 to 5 hours. Serve with the sauce spooned over.

rows.symptom: The meatballs are falling apart in the sauce
rows.cause: Turkey mince has very little fat to bind the mixture. Under-mixing or using too little breadcrumb can cause them to break up.
rows.fix: Stir the meat through the sauce and serve as a tomato mince instead. Next time add an extra egg and 2 more tablespoons of breadcrumbs.

rows.cause: Turkey mince can dry out if cooked past 5 hours on LOW.
rows.fix: Stir them gently through the sauce so they reabsorb some liquid. Next time check at 4 hours.

rows.cause: Turkey mince has less fat than beef and carries seasoning less well.
rows.fix: Add a teaspoon of salt to the sauce and cook for 10 more minutes. A pinch of chilli flakes lifts the whole dish.

rows.cause: They were added raw to the sauce without browning first.
rows.fix: Brown them in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side before adding to the slow cooker. This gives colour and a slightly crispier edge.

content.text: Turkey meatballs occupy the same category as turkey mince chilli: a lighter version of a familiar dish that does not compromise on satisfaction. They became common in British home cooking as turkey moved from a once-a-year celebration meat to a year-round protein. The slow cooker keeps them moist in a way that a hot oven cannot.
